target_test: PatternKind round-trips through the outcome store codec without corruption
rationale: PatternOutcomeStore serializes PatternKind with sprintf "%A" but parseKind is a lowercasing substring matcher whose Custom fallthrough re-wraps the whole string, adding one custom-quoting layer per load/append (live records nest ~80 layers; 25/231 corrupted, worsening on every write). Make parseKind (keep the name) an exact inverse of the %A print for every case, including Custom. Research: docs/research/empirical-learning-curves.md, theory-mcts-skill-search.md.

target_test: bayesianUpdate keeps a fresh rule's posterior non-degenerate
rationale: bayesianUpdate with priorCount=0 (every rule from fromRecurrenceRecords starts at SelectionCount=0) collapses the posterior to exactly 1.0/0.0 on the first observation — one data point becomes certainty. Add Beta(1,1)-style pseudo-counts so the posterior stays strictly inside (0,1). Research: docs/research/theory-bayesian-grammar-induction.md.

target_test: updateWeight folds the Bayesian posterior into the ranking Weight
rationale: updateWeight advances SuccessRate/Confidence but never touches Weight, the field classifyWeighted actually ranks by — so execution outcomes can never change promotion order, and live promotion state shows r(SuccessRate, Weight) = -0.85. Recompute Weight from the posterior on each update (respect MinWeight). Research: docs/research/theory-bayesian-grammar-induction.md, empirical-promotion-dynamics.md.

target_test: replicator step preserves the smoothing floor after renormalization
rationale: step clamps proportions to SmoothingFloor BEFORE renormalizing, so a floored species is rescaled below the floor and the documented 1% diversity guarantee does not hold — the only guard against monoculture fixation is broken. Enforce the floor as a post-normalization invariant. Research: docs/research/theory-replicator-dynamics.md.

target_test: a pattern name alone does not satisfy RemovesComplexity
rationale: The live pipeline proposes candidates with PatternTemplate = the pattern's name (run: propose candidate.Record.PatternName) and RemovesComplexity is a bare non-emptiness check, so every named pattern trivially 'removes complexity' — one of the criteria inflations behind the governor's 95.7% approval rate. validateDeterministic must reject a template that is literally the candidate's own name. Research: docs/research/frontier-program-synthesis.md, empirical-promotion-dynamics.md.
